experimental_models_25.mechanism: Exponential pattern capacity retrieving full episodes from `≥ 50%` occluded cues in 1–3 settling steps.

experimental_models_25.name: Kolmogorov-Arnold Spline/LUT Networks (KAN)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Piecewise-polynomial/LUT univariate edge functions for compact, interpretable visceral control laws.

experimental_models_25.name: Continuous Neural ODEs / Langevin Neural SDEs
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Continuous vector fields coupling physiology and neural state (requires multi-bit precision ≥ FP16).

experimental_models_25.name: Developmental Hypernetworks / Coordinate CPPNs
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Compact genome queries 3D tissue coordinates `(x,y,z,d)` at developmental milestones (Gear 4).

experimental_models_25.name: Sparse Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE Specialist Router)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Activates only `k_exp = 1..2` specialist spheres per step, decoupling capacity from per-tick FLOPs.

experimental_models_25.name: Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) & Chemoton Tissue Grids
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Local neighbor signaling grows, polarizes, and regenerates multicellular soft soma after injury.

experimental_models_25.name: Hierarchical Predictive Coding / Active Inference
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Top-down predictions cancel expected sensory input; precision-weighted residuals drive belief & action.

experimental_models_25.name: Multi-Compartment Apical-Basal Dendritic Units (dCaAP)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Segregated basal drive + apical context calcium plateaus solving single-cell XOR (Gidon et al. 2020).

experimental_models_25.name: Three-Factor Eligibility + BTSP Plateau Plasticity
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Decaying `pre × post` tags converted to weight updates on delayed phasic neuromodulator/plateau arrival.

experimental_models_25.name: Constant-Memory Gated Recurrence (xLSTM / RWKV-lite)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Matrix-valued recurrent memory cells maintaining constant `O(1)` step cost over unbounded lifetimes.

experimental_models_25.name: Part-Whole Pose Capsule / Frame Networks
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Tracks object-to-body and segment-to-segment coordinate frames across viewpoint/posture shifts.

experimental_models_25.name: Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks (Morphology GNN)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Propagates tension, perfusion, and proprioception natively over variable-limb soft body graphs.

experimental_models_25.name: Energy-Based Settling Networks (Ising / Equilibrium)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Relaxes fast threat/posture constraints on a bounded Lyapunov energy surface (`K_iter ≤ 8`).

experimental_models_25.name: 2-Step Consistency / Flow-Matching Motor Policies
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Generates smooth multimodal soft-continuum obstacle-avoidance trajectories in 2 fixed denoiser steps.

experimental_models_25.name: Hyperdimensional / Vector-Symbolic Algebras (VSA / MAP)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: SIMD bitwise/XOR/permutation role-filler binding over `1,024–4,096d` bipolar/ternary vectors.

experimental_models_25.name: Event-Driven Address-Event Neuromorphic Cores (AER)
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Asynchronous event queues touching outgoing edges strictly on threshold crossings.

experimental_models_25.name: Multi-Scale Frankenstein Organ Hybrids
experimental_models_25.mechanism: Principled composition: NCA/XPBD soma + int4 CfC ganglia + sLTC/Hopfield/Workspace central brain.

geometries_25.name: Typed Metric Vector Spaces
geometries_25.grounding: Explicit unit-tagged coordinate spaces linking transducers, latents, and motor targets.

geometries_25.name: Bilateral / Radial Group-Symmetric Wiring
geometries_25.grounding: Mirrors paired left-right or radial soft-segment circuits from one compact genomic specification.

geometries_25.name: Clifford (Geometric) Algebra Rotors
geometries_25.grounding: Encodes 2D/3D orientations, bivector torques, and soft-segment bends without gimbal singularities.

geometries_25.name: Hyperbolic (Poincaré / Lorentz) Manifolds
geometries_25.grounding: Embeds exponential phylogenetic, taxonomic, and subgoal trees cleanly (requires FP16/FP32 adapter).

geometries_25.name: Spherical & Toroidal Phase Manifolds
geometries_25.grounding: Wrap-around topology for compass headings, circadian phases, and multi-limb gait oscillators.

geometries_25.name: Contractive Induced-Norm Manifolds (`‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99`)
geometries_25.grounding: Bounds singular values (`‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99`, implying `ρ(W) ≤ 0.99`) to prevent transient & asymptotic blowup.

geometries_25.name: 3D Distance-Delay Tissue Wiring
geometries_25.grounding: Axonal connection probability, metabolic wire rent, and integer spike delay scale with 3D tissue distance.

geometries_25.name: Watts-Strogatz Small-World Connectomes
geometries_25.grounding: High local clustering plus sparse long-range shortcuts yielding `O(log N)` broadcast at low cable volume.

geometries_25.name: Scale-Free Rich-Club Hub Networks
geometries_25.grounding: Heavy-tailed hub architecture supporting targeted hub-vs-periphery lesion resilience assays.

geometries_25.name: Hub-and-Sphere Modular Bottlenecks
geometries_25.grounding: Dense specialist spheres communicating exclusively through capacity-limited workspace/thalamic hubs.

geometries_25.name: Recursive L-System Vascular & Axonal Trees
geometries_25.grounding: Self-similar branching rules growing perfusion vessels and peripheral nerve trunks from tiny genomes.

geometries_25.name: Persistent Homology (Betti-0/1/2 Signatures)
geometries_25.grounding: Diagnostic topological audit of ring attractors, toroidal maps, and soft-cavity loops.

geometries_25.name: SE(2) / SE(3) Equivariant Steerable Kernels
geometries_25.grounding: Guarantees rotational/translational equivariance for local tactile/odor/visual feature detectors (≥int8/FP16).

geometries_25.name: Cellular Sheaf Consensus Maps
geometries_25.grounding: Linear edge restriction maps reconciling disagreements across heterogeneous sensory coordinate frames.

geometries_25.name: Sinkhorn Optimal-Transport Somatotopy
geometries_25.grounding: Smoothly remaps variable-node larval/adult skin and retina sheets onto fixed cortical arrays.

geometries_25.name: Corecursive Stream Coalgebra Interfaces
geometries_25.grounding: Formalizes open-ended organism-environment step transitions as typed `(State × Input) -> (State × Output)`.

geometries_25.name: Decursive Self-Deduplication (DSD)
geometries_25.grounding: Alex Donahue's reserved novel concept (preserved verbatim as author-defined slot per specification).

geometries_25.name: Juvenile Overproduction & Sleep Pruning
geometries_25.grounding: Synaptogenesis overshoot followed by size-scaled NREM activity-dependent pruning and waking re-sprout.

geometries_25.name: Amari Mexican-Hat Neural & Morphogen Fields
geometries_25.grounding: Local excitation + surround inhibition sheets driving spatial attention peaks and Turing skin patterns.

geometries_25.name: Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR)
geometries_25.grounding: Circular-convolution binding (`O(D log D)` FFT or `O(D)` permutations) for compositional symbol structures.

geometries_25.name: Continuous Attractor Bump Sheets (Ring / Hex)
geometries_25.grounding: Translation-invariant recurrent sheets integrating velocity into dead-reckoned heading and place bumps.

geometries_25.name: k-WTA Sparse Distributed Representations (2% SDR)
geometries_25.grounding: Top-2% winner-take-all expansion (clean-slate design target inspired by 5–10% fly Kenyon sparsity).

geometries_25.name: Ramon-y-Cajal Wiring-Volume Minimization
geometries_25.grounding: Co-evolves ganglion placement inside the soft body to minimize `Sum(weight_volume × distance)` ATP rent.

geometries_25.name: Simplicial / Hypergraph Triadic Couplings
geometries_25.grounding: Captures 3-way neuron-astrocyte-modulator gates and multi-agent social coalitions natively.

geometries_25.name: Nested Brains-Within-Brains + Typed S2S Bridges
geometries_25.grounding: Multi-level hierarchy (`b1.58/int4` limbs -> `int8` cortex -> `BF16/FP32` mind) linked by `S2S` adapters.

Insert, unbind, or reweight associative role-filler vectors with norm renormalization.
Transition Ring-1/2 organ precision (e.g. `FP16 -> int4` via keyed stochastic rounding + S2S update).
Project matrix onto Dale's-law sign mask, zero-row-sum, or orthogonal/spectral ball `‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99`.
Fork/fuse Ring-1 modules or apply MHC-verified horizontal plasmid graft (when niche-enabled).
Consolidate plastic skill masks; `Ring-0` brainstem, nociception & First-Law ledger permanently read-only.

Multicellular morphogenesis & Chemoton homeostasis (coupled to FP64 ledger).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Rigid-Sphere Embodiment Gap
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Modeling organisms as rigid circles/spheres eliminates compliant gripping, narrow-gap squeezing, peristalsis, and passive terrain damping.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Build 2D/3D XPBD viscoelastic membrane + `|ΔV|/V_0 < 1%` hydrostatic coelom (`SOFT01–SOFT10`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Missing Wet Autopoietic Core
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Single scalar `energy` counters lack stoichiometric coupling between metabolism, membrane surface area, and template replication.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Implement Gánti Chemoton (`A`, lipid `T`, polymer `pV_n`) + Michaelis-Menten saturation (`SOFT21–SOFT25`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Missing Sensorimotor Forward Model
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Without an internal efference-copy predictor, self-generated soft-body deformation triggers false external threat/obstacle reflexes.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Wire motor-to-sensory forward predictor (`AE-2`, `M073`) subtracting expected self-reafference.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: No Metamorphosis / Cell Sorting
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Scalar mass growth omits embryonic cell sorting, apoptotic sculpting, and larval-to-adult body remodeling with memory survival.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Implement Steinberg adhesion, apoptosis, and Blackiston-assay pupal remodeling (`SOFT32–35`, `M084`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Missing Sham & Passive Controls
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Comparing Intact only against uncalibrated cuts conflates passive body physics and random damage size with true circuit function.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Require 4 core arms + `Size-Matched Sham Lesion` + `Competent Simple Baseline` (`P6`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Unseparated Weight vs Plasticity RAM
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Counting only packed weight bits hides eligibility queues, consolidation cascades, masks, neuron states, and GPU staging buffers.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Enforce full-process memory inventory separating packed weights from bounded `+0.40 B/syn` plasticity rings (`ALF-004`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: SharedArrayBuffer Origin Isolation
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Browsers disable `SharedArrayBuffer` unless top-level `COOP: same-origin` + `COEP: require-corp` headers establish `crossOriginIsolated`.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Assert `self.crossOriginIsolated === true` at boot (`HW14`); fall back cleanly to double-buffered `postMessage` transfer.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Mobile/Laptop Thermal Throttling
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Sustained SIMD/WebGPU bursts push mobile silicon past 90°C, dropping host clocks and desynchronizing wall-clock assumptions.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Decouple integer `sim_tick` from `wall_time`; drive contiguous Frame-Time Governor (`HW21`) via EMA `ms/frame`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Spreadsheet 1,048,576-Row Ceiling
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Dumping raw spike rasters or synapse tables directly into `.xlsx`/`.xls` crashes writers or silently truncates past `1,048,576` rows.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Route full tensors to `Parquet`/`HDF5`; auto-shard `.xls`/`.xlsx` into `≤ 500K`-row summary sheets + manifests.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Multi-Artifact Specification Drift
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Editing PDFs, CSVs, JSON, and workbooks by hand causes IDs, byte totals, and Cube cells to diverge across files.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Generate all 9 output formats (`PDF, JSON, MD, XML, TXT, YAML, HTML, CSV, XLS`) from one canonical v3.0 schema + audit script.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Lossy UI Ring vs Lossless Audit
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Sharing one circular buffer between a 60 Hz UI sparkline and scientific benchmark logging drops audit events under burst load.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Separate overwrite-allowed UI telemetry rings (with explicit `gap_count`) from backpressure-safe lossless Export/Audit streams.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Broken Git Worktree Provenance
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Copied directories containing broken `.git` pointer files lack object stores, invalidating commit SHA provenance in test manifests.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Gate Stage 0 (`M003`, `GATE-01`) on `git rev-parse --verify HEAD` + clean working-tree manifest hash.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Continuum FEM Fidelity vs Evo Speed
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: High-element 3D continuum FEM (`~50 ms/step`) precludes multi-generation evolutionary sweeps on single workstations.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Evolve on fixed-mesh XPBD hydrostats (`0.5 ms` Gear 0); validate selected genotypes in high-resolution continuum.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Cross-OS Bit-Exactness vs GPU Speed
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Parallel WebGPU/CUDA float reductions are non-associative, preventing bit-identical hashes against sequential CPU code.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Tier-1 CPU/WASM canonical mode enforces bit-exact hashes; Tier-2 GPU bulk mode verifies preregistered observable tolerances.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Open-Ended Speciation vs Fixed Floors
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Locomotor foraging floors unfairly penalize lineages evolving into sessile filter-feeders, ambushers, or decomposers.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Enforce universal First-Law + autopoietic viability globally; score behavioral competence per MAP-Elites guild cell.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Compact Indirect GRN vs Mutational Lethality
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Indirect developmental GRN/NCA encodings compress genomes dramatically but risk catastrophic embryonic instability under point mutation.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Canalize embryogenesis via bioelectric polarity clamping (`SOFT37`) and homeostatic `iSTDP`/synaptic scaling (`M045`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Per-Agent Retina/Cochlea vs Crowd Scale
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Full 2D RGBD retinas for 500 crowd organisms saturate integrated GPU bandwidth, yet changing rays alters Tier-1 trajectory hashes.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Keep sensor config fixed for all agents in Tier-1 canonical runs; enable salience-scheduled crowd LOD strictly in Tier-2.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Live Hardware Sensors vs Repeatability
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Live webcam/microphone/IMU inputs provide genuine open-world entropy but cannot repeat deterministically across CI runs.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ruling: Explore live in Practice mode while recording immutable timestamped `.sensorlog` streams replayed bit-exactly in Test gates.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: 24 GB/s Naive Live Synapse Streaming
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Streaming `10^8 × 4 B × 60 Hz = 24 GB/s` across threads violates memory-bus budgets and stalls simulation workers.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: Stream `O(1)` statistical sketches (`≤ 32 KB/fr`) globally; pull subgraph slices on demand (`2 Hz`) for inspected organs.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Full 825-Suite Per Online WSE Edit
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Running full held-out benchmark suites on every millisecond in-life `WSE` plasticity edit freezes runtime execution.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: 3-Tier WSE Gate—Tier-0 `O(1)` induced-norm `‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99` + ATP check online, Tier-1 sleep shadow rollout, Tier-2 promotion.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Underpowered & Mislabeled FDR Stats
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Conflating Holm-Bonferroni FWER with FDR `q`-values or claiming `N=16` powers 100-item medium-effect families invites false claims.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: Exact paired Wilcoxon/sign-flip + **Holm-Bonferroni FWER (`α ≤ 0.05`)**, power-sized `N` (`24..120`), `δ_pair`, and `LCB_95% > -Δ_NI`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Z-Blind 2D Cube Compatibility
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Scoring `Model × Precision` while ignoring `Geometry Z` misses hyperbolic (`Z4`), attractor (`Z5`), and steerable (`Z6`) low-bit failures.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: Full 3-axis `evaluateCubeCell(X, Y, Z)` with grayscale-safe `[OK] / [OVER] / [ADAPT] / [EXCL]` synced across PDF & CSV/XLS.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Shared PRNG & World-Entity Coupling
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Drawing random numbers sequentially or failing to isolate world weather from creature organs scrambles trajectories upon ablation.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: `Philox4x32-10` keyed by `(ver, seed, domain, entity, organ, tick, purpose, idx)` isolating `WORLD_EXOG` from `ENTITY_INT`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Circular Parameter Count & Exact-Φ Claims
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Equating parameter count with competence or claiming exact `O(2^N)` IIT `Φ` on large brains is scientifically invalid.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Corrected: Require forked-snapshot perturbational `PCI*` (`F2`), `C-NC` causal divergence, and Competent Simple Baselines.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Cross-OS libm Transcendental ULP Drift
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Host `Math.exp`/`Math.log`/`Math.tanh` implementations vary by `1–2 ULP` across OS/browser engines, breaking bit-exact hashes.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Ship core-owned versioned deterministic minimax/LUT `exp_det`, `log_det`, `pow_det`, and `tanh_det` in Tier-1 runtime.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Explicit Euler Soft-Spring Explosion & Free Energy
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Explicit Euler explodes on stiff membranes, while unmonitored XPBD constraint projections can inject or dissipate unbooked energy.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Use XPBD (`α̃ = α/dt²`) + book positive solver damping to `E_diss_num ≥ 0` and fault on `ΔE_diss_num < -1e-15`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: FP32 Small-Addend Absorption in Ledger
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Adding `1e-6 kJ` spike heat to a `1e5 kJ` dome heat accumulator in `FP32` (`24` mantissa bits) rounds the increment completely to `0`.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Accumulate all 11 enthalpy/mass pools in `FP64` with Kahan-Neumaier compensation (`|ΔE|/(E0+Ein) < 1e-12`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: JS 32-Bit Shift Wraparound (`1 << 32 === 1`)
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: In JS/C-style 32-bit shifts, `1 << Q` masks `Q & 31` (`Q=32` allocates 2 floats instead of guarding, while `Q=30` overflows signed int32!).
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Validate `Number.isInteger(Q) && Q >= 0 && Q <= 10` first, then allocate `2 * (2 ** Q)` `Float64` values (`≤ 16 KiB`).

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Per-Tick Closures, BigInt Box & WASM Grow
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Temporary closures, `BigInt` boxing in JS PRNGs, or dynamic WASM `memory.grow` inside `tick()` trigger latency spikes and view invalidation.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Pre-allocate fixed SoA arenas; use `Math.imul` 32-bit `Philox4x32-10`; assert `0` allocs & `0` page grows across `10,000` ticks.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Lesion Toggle Resurrecting Pruned Wires
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Restoring a reversible lesion by setting mask bits to `1` overwrites `0`s created by developmental or sleep pruning.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Maintain orthogonal `structuralMask` (ontogeny/sleep) and `lesionMask` (assay), applying `effectiveMask = structuralMask & lesionMask`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Epistemic Curiosity vs Starvation Urgency
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Additive novelty bonuses overpower homeostatic error when fuel runs low, causing starving organisms to inspect noisy traps.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Multiplicative Urgency Gate: weight epistemic value by sigmoid survival margin `σ((TTC - TTC_crit)/τ)`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: In-Life WSE Surgery vs Autonomic Survival
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Self-editing operators optimizing short-horizon reward silence nociceptors, cardiac pacemakers, or metabolic accounting.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Hardware-enforced Protection Rings: `Ring-0` (`brainstem, nociception, ledger, harness`) uses frozen read-only views.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Cuticle Armor Stiffening vs Squeeze/Speed
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Inducible cuticle thickening shields against toxins/bites but raises bending energy, mass, and narrow-aperture failure.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Expose as regulated endocrine/catch-state trade-off (`SOFT04`) modulated by predator/toxin threat cues.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Fast Hebbian LTP vs Recurrent Runaway
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Positive Hebbian loops without rapid counterbalance saturate firing rates or collapse into epileptic synchrony.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Couple 3-factor LTP with fast inhibitory `iSTDP`, sliding BCM threshold, `‖W‖_2 ≤ 0.99` guard, and NREM `SHY`.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Exotic Field Senses vs Anti-LARP Physics
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Simulated bioelectric or distant-sensing channels degenerate into zero-cost oracle cheats if unattenuated.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Mediate every exotic sense through inverse-distance noisy in-world fields with strict per-bit ATP debit and shuffle controls.

forensic_triage_registry_36.title: Concurrent Multi-Organ State Write Races
forensic_triage_registry_36.hazard: Sleep flip-flop, HPA cortisol, and workspace writing shared `arousal` in arbitrary order produce order-dependent oscillations.
forensic_triage_registry_36.resolution: Single-writer variable ownership + canonical deterministic reducer over double-buffered `prevTick -> nextTick` state.

statistical_power_protocol.primaryTest: Two-sided or preregistered directional exact paired Wilcoxon signed-rank / 2^N sign-flip permutation test on locked seed pairs d_i = Y_intact(s_i) - Y_ctrl(s_i).
statistical_power_protocol.effectSize: Within-pair dominance δ_pair = (count(d_i > 0) - count(d_i < 0)) / N_pairs (reported alongside unpaired Cliff's δ for archival cross-lineage comparisons); default threshold δ_pair ≥ 0.33 (medium) or ≥ 0.50 (structural gates).
statistical_power_protocol.multiplicityControl: Holm-Bonferroni step-down Family-Wise Error Rate (FWER) control at α_FWER ≤ 0.05 within each checklist family (reports p_raw and p_Holm; never mislabeled as false-discovery rate).
statistical_power_protocol.singlePrimaryContrastRule: Each checklist item preregisters ONE primary causal contrast (typically Intact vs Targeted-Lesion or Intact vs Sham-Lesion) entering the familywise m-count; secondary arms (Passive-Body, Shuffled, Competent-Simple) act as mandatory gate Conjunctive Guardrails.
powerSizingTiers: Small Suite / Large Effect (m ≤ 25: WSE-12, Butlin-14, F10, HW-24, CQM-25)
Min achievable two-sided sign-flip p = 1.19e-7; clears Holm α/25 = 0.002 at ≥85% power for δ_pair ≥ 0.55.
Medium Suite / Strong Effect (m = 40–100: SOFT-40, FREAK-100, NOVEL-100)
Clears Holm α/100 = 0.0005 for strong physiological/ablation effects (δ_pair ≥ 0.50).
Large Suite / Moderate Behavioral Effect (m = 100–500: subtle cognition/ecology)
Sample-size set from Tuning-seed variance pilot; underpowered tests report `Inconclusive ◌` (never Fail or Pass).
statistical_power_protocol.burnOnFailRule: Any Locked Held-Out Test seed block evaluated on a failed promotion attempt is permanently retired to `Historical-Audit` and replaced by a fresh unseen seed block (`≥ 5000 + offset`) before re-testing.
statistical_power_protocol.nonInferiorityRule: Regression protection on previously locked floors (`🔒`) uses a one-sided 95% paired confidence lower bound `LCB_95%(Y_new - Y_anchor) > -Δ_NI` (reserving two-sided TOST `[-Δ_eq, +Δ_eq]` strictly for Tier-2 vs Tier-1 numerical equivalence).

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Correct the memory chart's arithmetic and units
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 39, Model 8 and §9.1; Blueprint p. 9, Model 8
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: 100 CREATURES × 10⁸ SYNAPSES EACH; 5.0 B/syn 5.0 GB; 0.48 B/syn 480 MB; 96 B/syn 800 GB
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: There are 10^10 synapses. At 5, 1.5, and 0.48 bytes/synapse, totals are 50 GB, 15 GB, and 4.8 GB, not 5 GB, 1.5 GB, and 480 MB. The chart also labels its OOP baseline 96 B/syn but gives 800 GB; 96 B implies 960 GB. The 800 GB total corresponds to 80 B/syn. GB here is decimal; changing to GiB does not fix the factor of ten.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Generate chart and table from a single byte-count calculation; choose one stated OOP baseline, show decimal GB or explicitly label GiB, and update laptop-fit statements. Preserve the conditional 167× ratio if comparing 80 B/syn to 0.48 B/syn: 80/0.48≈166.7. It is the displayed totals, not that ratio alone, that are wrong.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: For 100 creatures with 10^8 stored synapses each: the printed 96 B/syn baseline implies 960 GB; a separately declared 80 B/syn baseline would imply 800 GB. At 5 B/syn, 1.5 B/syn and 0.48 B/syn, totals are 50 GB, 15 GB and 4.8 GB. Use one consistent baseline in the chart and ratios. These are representation-only estimates; total process memory is reported separately.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Assert total_bytes = creature_count × synapse_count × bytes_per_synapse for every row.; Ensure the bar lengths and text use the same generated data.; Recalculate every derived compression ratio and hardware-fit conclusion.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: Sec 6.2 `MEMORY_COMPRESSION_ROWS` + Model 12 SVG (`100×10^8 = 10^10` syn exact decimal bytes)

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Define a fair dense-versus-sparse memory comparison
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 39, Model 8 and §9.1; Blueprint p. 9, Model 8
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Dense FP32 Matrix (N²); 4.0 B/u²; 40.0 GB; Wastes 95%+ bandwidth on zero/absent connections
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The dense row uses bytes per possible unit pair while sparse rows use bytes per stored synapse, but no unit count or edge density is declared. A dense matrix of N units stores N² entries; E stored edges is a different quantity. The displayed 400 MB per dense creature silently assumes N²=10^8, which is incompatible with treating E=10^8 and >95% of possible connections absent.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Declare unit count N, actual edge count E, sparsity E/N², directed/self-edge conventions, and dense storage 4N². Compare equivalent graphs and precision separately from topology compression.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Dense bytes = 4N². CSR bytes = E(b_weight + b_index + b_delay) + (N+1)b_rowptr + alignment and metadata. Report N and E for every scenario.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: For a fixed graph, compute both exact allocated byte totals.; Keep topology sparsity savings separate from weight-precision savings.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: Sec 6.2 `MEMORY_BENCHMARK_GRAPH` (`N=50,000, E=10^8, ρ=4%`, dense `4N² = 10.0 GB` / `1.00 TB` + Tier-L `8.59 GB`)

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Reconcile packed int4/ternary estimates with the actual block layout
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework pp25, 32, 39; HW04, P03/P05, Model 8; Blueprint pp9–10; Model 8, HW04
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: 0.48 B/syn; 32-Synapse Cache-Line Block (19 Bytes total = 0.59 B/syn)
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The illustrated block is 16 B for 32 int4 weights plus 3 B overhead: 19/32=0.59375 B/syn, not 0.48. Uncompressed fixed-width int4 weights alone require 0.5 B/syn. Mixed ternary packing could average below 0.5, but no mixture, codec, index representation, padding, or metadata calculation is supplied. Five ternary weights per byte is possible because 3^5=243, but does not include scales/indices and is not the same as arbitrary 1.58-bit addressable storage.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Provide separate int4 and ternary layouts and compute their effective bytes including metadata. Do not apply a 0.48-B average to the 19-byte int4 example. Identify the base-tile/seed range represented by the single metadata byte and the cost of overflow blocks.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Example int4 block: 32 weights × 4 bits + 2-byte scale + 1-byte local block tag = 19 bytes, or 0.59375 B/weight before row pointers, alignment, and learning state. A mixed-format average must be calculated from declared proportions and codecs.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Round-trip all code values and block boundaries.; Measure allocated bytes for multiple graph sizes and ragged final blocks.; Confirm claimed addressing range and alignment.

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Budget learning and runtime state separately from compressed weights
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework pp11, 25, 39–40; F050/F051/F054, HW03–06, hardware tiers; Blueprint pp10, 21–22; HW03–06, M047/M052
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Bitpacked int4 / Ternary ... + Sparse Eligibility Queue; 0.48 B / syn; Fusi Metaplastic Consolidation Cascade
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The claimed per-synapse totals are not reconciled with eligibility traces, multiple consolidation states, structural/lesion masks, delays, optimizer/readout state, event queues, reverse adjacency, arena headroom, snapshots, and CPU/GPU replicas. Sparse queues only save memory if occupancy is bounded and their worst-case full activity is accounted for.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Publish an allocation inventory with fixed and activity-dependent terms, separate weights from learning state, and declare queue overflow policy. Require measured peak resident RAM and VRAM, not only weight-byte estimates.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Total memory = weights + topology + neuron states + plasticity/consolidation state + event queues + body/world grids + snapshots/telemetry + duplicated device buffers + allocator headroom. Report typical and declared worst-case activity.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Saturate eligibility and spike queues within allowed workload.; Verify peak process and device allocations against the declared tier.; Measure memory before/after snapshots, exports, and structural edits.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: Sec 6.2 Separate Plasticity/Runtime Inventory (`+0.40 B/syn` sparse eligibility cap + `CSR` rewire overlay + SoA state)

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Specify index widths for large connectomes
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework pp25, 39–40; HW03, CSR row, workstation tier; Blueprint pp9–10; workstation tier, HW03
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: FP16 w + uint16 idx + uint8 delay; 100K+ Units/Brain
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: A global uint16 endpoint index can address only 65,536 unit IDs, while the reference workstation tier permits 100K+ units per brain. Tiled local indices can work, but require an explicit tile/base encoding and additional memory. The same 5-B/synapse figure cannot silently cover both global and local representations.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Specify global uint32 indices or a documented tile-local scheme, include row-pointer width and base tables in byte accounting, and state the delay-unit/range encoded by uint8.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Use uint16 endpoints only within a declared ≤65,536-unit index domain. Larger brains use uint32 endpoints or tile-local indices plus explicit base tables; all metadata counts toward memory budgets.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Round-trip edges spanning unit IDs 65,535, 65,536, and the declared maximum.; Test rewiring across tiles and arena growth without index truncation.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: Sec 6.2 & `HW03`: tiled `uint16` (`≤65,536`/tile + explicit `row_tile_ptr`) vs `uint32` (`9.25 B/syn`) for `>65K` units

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Correct TF32's storage claim
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 32, P16
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: TF32 (19-bit TensorCore math) | 19 bits | 1.7×
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: TF32 is presented as a 19-bit memory storage format giving 1.7× RAM saving. Ordinary TF32-mode tensor operations use FP32 storage; the current CUDA __nv_tf32 type also occupies 32 bits with 4-byte alignment despite 19 value bits. Reduced multiplication precision does not yield the claimed storage reduction.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Separate storage width from compute precision; set ordinary TF32-mode tensor storage to 32 bits and RAM saving to 1× relative to FP32. Any custom 19-bit codec would be a different software storage format requiring conversion.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: TF32: 19 value bits/effective arithmetic precision with ordinary 32-bit storage (4-byte aligned for CUDA __nv_tf32); 1× storage relative to FP32. Throughput and API availability depend on hardware and operation.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Check tensor element size and allocated bytes in a TF32-enabled workload.; Do not infer RAM savings from multiply precision.

errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Locked Held-Out Test Pass → Regression Floor Locked
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: A formerly held-out seed set becomes an adaptive development target when used repeatedly for regression, operator promotion or visible benchmark tuning. Disjoint numeric seed ranges and an AST rule against seed literals do not define access control, reveal policy, retry limits, seed retirement or model-selection history.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Distinguish practice/tuning, public locked regression and fresh final qualification sets. Record every evaluation and the decisions it influenced. Promote historical test cases into regression explicitly rather than continuing to call them untouched held-out evidence.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Regression sets may be reused and are labeled development evidence. Final qualification uses a separately controlled fresh set and a preregistered decision rule. A revealed final set is retired into regression; subsequent qualification uses new cases or a declared sequential-testing policy.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Run manifests identify the set's role, access history and number of evaluations.; Repeated tuning against a revealed set cannot be reported as fresh held-out confirmation.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: `SPEC_META` & Sec 7 callout: reports `825` raw checks, `5` exact direct mirrors (`820`), and `~775` distinct conceptual mechanisms

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Make pass status conditional on revision and retain failures
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 6 five-state lifecycle; p. 31 Tab13; p. 41 signoff; Blueprint p. 5 D8; p. 26 M100; p. 28 signoff
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Regression Floor Locked
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The lifecycle has only progress states and does not define failed, inconclusive, invalidated, not-applicable or superseded evidence. A locked checkbox can become misleading after changes to code, model weights, assay, physics or numeric mode unless its dependencies and validity are explicit.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Separate implementation status, evaluation outcome and evidence validity. Tie every result to versioned artifacts and invalidate affected claims after relevant changes; preserve historical runs rather than overwriting them.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: A pass is scoped to an implementation/model revision, assay version, data/seed set and runtime profile. Later changes may invalidate it. Failed, inconclusive, not-applicable and superseded outcomes remain visible; 'locked' means immutable historical evidence, not a permanent guarantee for future revisions.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Changing a dependency invalidates or schedules requalification of all dependent gates.; Historical failed and superseded results remain accessible and cannot be silently converted into passes.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: Repaired all 6 broken internal ID cross-references (`DIL-02/ERR-01`, `HW14`, `HW21`, `SOFT17/21`, `WSE-OP`, `PM/MF/GW`)

errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Operational Verification Requirement (4-Arm Causal Assay)
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: Structural/interface requirements, provenance checks, numerical invariants, computational budgets and behavioral capabilities need different evidence. The universal framing encourages artificial significance tests for deterministic checks or weak behavioral substitutions for hard invariants.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Tag each gate as conformance, numerical, behavioral, statistical, performance or provenance; attach the appropriate evaluation contract. Use four-arm experiments only for claims those comparisons can identify.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Deterministic invariants use exhaustive/property/adversarial checks within a declared domain. Behavioral claims use predeclared causal comparisons and uncertainty estimates. Performance claims use reproducible benchmarks. Provenance claims use auditable records. No single assay type applies to all gates.

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Distinguish valid Git worktrees from broken copied pointers
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 27 ISS-06; p. 29 Stage0; p. 41 worksheet10.1; Blueprint p. 13 ISS-06; p. 28 GATE-01
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Copied folders with .git file pointers instead of full .git/ object stores break provenance hashes
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: A healthy linked Git worktree normally uses a .git file pointing to shared administrative data; that layout does not itself break provenance. A moved/copied worktree with dangling references is a distinct fault. The current wording does not make the distinction explicit. Requiring a standalone repository can be an intentional packaging policy, but should not be justified by implying that all worktree pointers invalidate provenance.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Validate repository resolution, object availability, recorded revision and worktree status with Git. Require a standalone clone or archive only when portability/self-contained delivery is part of the declared policy.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: A linked Git worktree with resolvable metadata is a valid repository layout. Reject dangling copied pointers or unavailable objects. If this project intentionally requires standalone repositories, retain that as an explicit portability/packaging policy and validate a self-contained clone or bundle; do not describe healthy worktrees as intrinsically invalid.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: A valid linked worktree passes provenance checks.; A copied directory with a broken gitdir pointer fails; the archival bundle can recover the recorded revision.

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Operationalize open-endedness as bounded evidence
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 8 CQM02; p. 21 N72/N73/N78; p. 27 DIL-03; Blueprint p. 16 CQM02; p. 26 M096–M098
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: continues discovering genuinely novel behavioral niches ... extended ecological time
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The open-endedness criterion does not define novelty representation, baseline, time horizon, observer bias, diversity metric, extinction handling or statistical replication. A finite run can demonstrate sustained novelty over that horizon; it cannot establish indefinite open-endedness from a single passing checkbox.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Specify descriptor space and novelty tests before evaluation, compare with fixed/random or non-evolving baselines, report plateau/extinction behavior and finite horizon. Preserve the larger research ambition while narrowing the claim supported by each run.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Report sustained novel behavioral/ecological discovery over a declared evaluation horizon using preregistered descriptors, diversity measures and baselines. This is bounded evidence toward open-endedness, not proof of indefinite novelty generation.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Novelty cannot be earned solely by arbitrary hash changes or continuously increasing an irrelevant numeric parameter.; The result includes all replicates, failures/extinctions and the declared observation horizon.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: `D5`, `HARDWARE_TIERS`, `P9`: fixed soft-body mesh resolution per experiment in Tier-1 canonical runs

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Distinguish within-life learning, inheritance and population selection
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework p. 8 CQM01/CQM07/CQM08; pp16–17 LIFE heredity/evolution; p. 20 N41/N48; Blueprint p. 16 CQM01/CQM07/CQM08; p. 22 M052/M055; p. 25 M088/M090
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: within-lifetime ... improves survival; Baldwin assimilation; inherited epigenetic threat priors
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The requirements do not fully state how evidence separates individual plasticity from better genomes, selective survival, direct weight inheritance and environmental exposure. A population's later average can improve without its individuals learning, and direct transmission of learned weights is a different mechanism from selection-mediated assimilation.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Assign distinct experiments and claims to within-life learning, inherited priors, direct policy transfer and evolutionary selection. Use matched initial genotypes/states, frozen-learning controls and explicit inheritance channels; include nonsurvivors in the outcome policy.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Within-life learning is evaluated on matched initial organisms with plasticity enabled versus disabled. Evolutionary change is evaluated across replicated lineages with explicit inheritance and selection rules. Direct transmission of acquired parameters is reported separately from selection-mediated changes in developmental priors.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: A population composed only of initially fitter survivors cannot pass the within-life learning gate by selection alone.; Each offspring parameter's origin is classified as inherited genomic, epigenetic, directly transferred learned state or newly learned.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_evidence: `BUG-06` & `WSE-OP02`: orthogonal `structuralMask` and `lesionMask` (`effectiveMask = structuralMask & lesionMask`)

errata_closure_register_95.Title: Separate editorial audit history from verified implementation results
errata_closure_register_95.Locations: Framework pp. 27–28, 42–43: forensic registry and 100-pass ledger; Blueprint pp. 13–14, 27: forensic registry and audit ledger
errata_closure_register_95.Anchor: Identified & Resolved; verified 0 regressions; 100-Pass
errata_closure_register_95.Problem: The documents describe proposed architectural cures and editorial changes using resolved, fixed, and verified language. The supplied files do not include the underlying per-pass records, prior revision, test outputs, or implementation artifacts needed to independently verify those claims. The zero-code starting point makes it especially important to distinguish an edited specification from a corrected and tested implementation. This finding does not establish that the claimed editorial passes never occurred.
errata_closure_register_95.Required_fix: Give every audit entry a scope (editorial, mathematical, implementation, or empirical), status, artifact reference, and reviewer/date. Keep historical statements that have evidence; label the others reported or proposed. Replace unconditional all-errors-fixed and zero-regression claims with the exact checks performed and their scope. Do not mark this errata list resolved until revised documents have been checked.
errata_closure_register_95.Suggested_replacement: Editorial revision ledger: this table records specification changes. An architectural remedy remains proposed until an implementation and verification artifact are linked. Audit pass count is a process record, not evidence that organism capabilities or performance targets have been demonstrated.
errata_closure_register_95.Closure_checks: Every fixed/resolved/verified assertion links to an inspectable artifact and identifies its scope.; Editorial completion cannot automatically set a capability or benchmark to passed.; The revised PDF states which checks were actually run and lists any remaining open issues.
